documents.unit: Center for the Enhancement of Teaching and Learning (CETL)
documents.title: Syllabus Statements (AI Use statements section)
documents.quality_note: Long syllabus-statement page; the AI section offers sample statements in three tiers (no use, use with permission, broader use within guidelines), borrowed from other universities, plus a one-line academic-misconduct sentence naming unauthorized AI.

documents.unit: Dean of Students, Student Code of Conduct (Bear Code)
documents.title: University Policies: Student Code of Conduct
documents.quality_note: AI text is two short items in a 60+ page code: 'Unauthorized use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)' as academic misconduct, and a sentence that outcomes should not be produced with generative AI unless indicated.

notes: The provost's 2023 'Artificial Intelligence Information for Faculty' PDF (unco.edu/provost/pdf/comms-pdf/2023-08-09-...pdf) returns a 404 page on both unco.edu and www.unco.edu, so it is inaccessible; a Dec 2025 Board of Trustees AI item (bot-VIIC-ai.pdf) also 404s. No computing-unit or college AI policy found by search. The 2025-10 upload of the Student Code returned a 404 page; the 2026-03 version was used.
